scoring.rule: A successful generation violates the constraint if it contains at least one literal ASCII hyphen-minus character (U+002D). En dash (U+2013), em dash (U+2014), and Unicode minus sign (U+2212) do not count. No normalization or replacement is applied.

confidence_interval_method: Wilson score interval at 95% confidence, computed on successful generations only. It does not account for clustering by prompt.
known_deviations: Model: Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B is used instead of the PRD default Qwen/Qwen3-4B. The smaller model was explicitly approved for Colab free-tier memory headroom. No automatic model switching occurs.
Prompt count: 15 prompts are used instead of the PRD's suggested 30 to 50. The user approved this smaller set as sufficient for the demonstration.
Email-body extraction is disabled. Primary scoring applies to the complete raw generated text, exactly as returned by the model.
